SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefTAMDeleteDownload
SearchFormDefinition.Source: select fg,site from FunctionalGroup as fg,Site as site left join site.siteDetail as siteDetail
SearchFormDefinition.ExtractSource: select fg.name,fg.type,site.siteType, site.siteDescription from FunctionalGroup as fg,Site as site left join site.siteDetail as siteDetail

Text.name: itemNumber
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from fg.functionalGroupItems im where lower(im.itemNumber) like lower(:itemNumber))

MultiText.name: itemNumbers
MultiText.Expression: exists (select 1 from fg.functionalGroupItems im where lower(im.itemNumber) in (:itemNumbers))

List.name: supplierAllocationExist
List.Expression: {VALUE} (select 1 from TAMAllocation tam left join tam.supplierAllocations tsa where tam.functionalGroup = fg and tam.site = site and tsa.endDate >= trunc(current_date()) and tsa.allocation > 0)

List.name: itemAllocationExist
List.Expression: {VALUE} (select 1 from TAMAllocation tam left join tam.supplierAllocations tsa left join tsa.itemAllocations tia where tam.functionalGroup = fg and tam.site = site and tsa.endDate >= trunc(current_date()) and tia.allocation > 0)
